subject: general
question: A bus travelling at 86 km/hr completes a journey in 7 hours. What should be its speed to cover the same distance in 14 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Time ratio = 7 : 14 = 1 : 2

Speed ratio = Inverse of time ratio = 2 : 1

Given speed (2 ratio parts) = 86 km/hr

Required speed (1 ratio part) = 86 ÷ 2 = 43 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 43 km/hr.**
